recipe.build:
mkdir -p ~/.gradle
cp .github/ci-gradle.properties ~/.gradle/gradle.properties
chmod +x gradlew
PROF_FILE=app/build/intermediates/binary_art_profile/release/compileReleaseArtProfile/baseline.prof
PROF_SHA1=dd1d36462f10e50e02632f0763515788d2d92c0f
for _ in {1..10}; do
./gradlew clean assembleRelease --no-build-cache --no-configuration-cache --no-daemon
find . -name 'baseline.prof'
test -f "$PROF_FILE"
if [ "$( sha1sum "$PROF_FILE" | cut -d' ' -f1 )" = "$PROF_SHA1" ]; then
break
fi
done
find . -name '*.apk'
mv app/build/outputs/apk/release/*unsigned.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
